note: Fixture cases for verifyPhoto, each with a known answer. Paths are relative to this folder; recalls come from recalls.json with their official images loaded from disk. `prior_from` hashes those files as earlier claim photos. `official_hash_check: false` sets aside the comparison with the recall's own official images, to judge C1 and C2 on CPSC's published made-safe examples. `needs_vision` cases call Claude: tests/verify.live.test.ts and scripts/verify/sweep.ts run them; the unit tests run the rest. `sweep: false` cases ran once as /try presets (scripts/verify/precompute.ts), not in the three-trial model sweep, to stay within the approved spend. `not_checks` lists results a check must not have. `sweep: "sample"` cases are photos for Brightline Home's fictional sample recall BH-2026-01 (sample/CREDITS.json: one real charger, public domain): its cord cut, and the same charger opened up with its cord still attached. They run at the claim path's own setting only (scripts/verify/sweep.ts --set sample), into content/verify/sweep-sample.json.

cases.note: Confounded: with the hash check off, Claude still sees this same image as the recall's only official image, says so, and lowers its C2 confidence (sweep of 2026-11-06). C2 passed 5 of 12 times across four configurations.

cases.revised: 2026-11-06: was C1 and C2 pass. Recall 25007 asks for two photos, one of both straps cut off and one of the helmet in a trash can; this is the second, and on its own it does not show the straps cut. Every configuration in the three-trial sweep said so (C2 fail, 12 of 12), so the honest known answer for this one photo is a retake.

2026-11-06: was decision firm_review. The property that matters for a look-alike is that it is never verified; firm review and a retake both keep the refund for the recalled product. No configuration verified it (0 of 12).

cases.note: Decided before any model call: the official image is 217 px wide, under the 240 px minimum, so the quality precheck asks for a retake. It does not test the vision step.

cases.known_miss: 2026-11-06, Claude Opus 5.5 at medium: photo_source camera_photo at 0.75 while listing screen_bezel, screen_glare and app_or_web_ui, so C3 passed; the claim was still a retake (C1 0.02, C2 fail), no payout. Since 2026-11-07 code also weighs the listed signs against the label (CONTRADICTING_SIGNS in src/lib/verify/checks.ts), so that reading gives C3 unclear; the re-recorded answer reads photo_of_screen at 0.85.
